description: This file defines a React component called PostForm used for creating or editing a blog post or travel story. It manages form state for title, content, images, tags, locations, tips, author, and publication status, with functions to add/remove tags, locations, tips, and images. It handles form submission and rendering of the form UI, including inputs, image uploader, tag chips, location chips, tip list, and submit/cancel buttons.

methods.name: PostForm
methods.description: React functional component for post creation/editing form. Manages multiple form fields and handles form submission.
